An applicant for a class B fire suppression piping contractor license may be permitted to use no more than three (3) years of experience working on 30 or fewer sprinkler heads towards satisfying the experience requirements in section 28-410.4.1 items 1 and 2, and no more than one (1) year towards satisfying the experience requirements in section 28-410.4.1 items 4 and 5.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022; Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126 and L.L. 2023/077.
